sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Cell-surface expression quantified (HaloTag labelling); odorant-evoked signaling efficacy measured (cAMP assay). Signaling was preserved across constructs; surface expression and signaling showed no correlation across orthologs, confirming both were independently assessed and the tag did not abolish function.
sites.rationale: The IL-6-HaloTag-pFN210A vector places HaloTag N-terminally on the full-length receptor; after IL-6 SP cleavage the HaloTag is extracellular. OR11A1 has no native signal peptide, so its M1 is the first residue of the mature protein and the tag prepends at position 0 (insert_after_residue=0, residue_after=M). No ledger line names a specific residue number, but the extracellular N-terminus (residues 1–26, 27 aa from TM1) is the only surface terminus available, making the junction topology-derived. L4 confirms both surface expression and signaling were measured in the same study. OR11A1 full-length coding sequence was cloned into the IL-6-HaloTag-pFN210A expression plasmid, which supplies an N-terminal IL-6 signal peptide followed by HaloTag immediately upstream of the OR11A1 ORF; the construct was expressed in HEK-293 cells. After IL-6 signal-peptide cleavage, HaloTag is the extracellular N-terminal moiety preceding OR11A1 residue M1. The N-terminus (residues 1–26) is the sole extracellular terminus of OR11A1; TM1 begins at residue 27 (F), leaving 27 residues of clearance. Signaling efficacies of OR11A1 and its orthologs were measured alongside cell-surface expression of the HaloTag-tagged constructs.

sources.claim: Amplicons were Eco RI/ Not I-digested (#R6017/#R6435; Promega, Madison, USA), ligated with T4-DNA ligase (#M1804; Promega, Madison, USA) into the expression plasmid IL-6-HaloTag-pFN210A, 58 and verified by Sanger sequencing (Eurofins Genomics, Ebersberg, Germany) using vector internal primers ( Table S3 ).

literature_notes: All four ledger lines (L1–L4) describe the same experimental system: OR11A1 (human) and its orthologs expressed as full-length receptors with an N-terminal IL-6 signal peptide + HaloTag via the IL-6-HaloTag-pFN210A plasmid in HEK-293 cells. No ledger line names a specific residue junction; the position is topology-derived from the single extracellular N-terminus. No internal loop insertions, C-terminal tags, or alternative sites are reported in the ledger. The three other extracellular loops (ECL1 85–98, ECL2 168–197, ECL3 263–270) have no ledger-grounded insertion evidence and are therefore not proposed as sites. HaloTag (~33 kDa) is substantially larger than the 13–23 aa ALFA-tag range specified, but it is the tag the ledger supports; the validated junction is the deliverable.
